title: Eleven Buttons
subtitle: 衬衫与上衣 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 衬衫与上衣（生活与学习·服饰与仪表）
meta: 主题语境：衬衫与上衣（生活与学习·服饰与仪表）　|　核心词汇：blouse　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 blouse 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 my mother was sent to iron ① a blouse she could not fasten, and she said the fastening was the whole of the lesson. The ② blouse, meaning the garment and not the buttons, had eleven buttons and was pressed by whoever came last; a blouse, she said, is the only thing in a wardrobe that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ blouse in that wardrobe had the same collar, and the ④ blouse on the line, meaning the one she wore to the interview and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever washed properly. A blouse, my grandmother said, is nine parts cotton and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the cotton is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ blouse was the whole of the summer, meaning the season it stood for and not the cloth. The ⑥ blouse, meaning the summer and not any of that, is the only thing in a house that everybody photographs and nobody questions; a blouse, he said, is either something you iron or the only word that means both a garment and a summer. She said the summer is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ blouse had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the cotton. The ⑧ blouse of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was eleven buttons and eleven years of ironing; a blouse, she said, is either the one on the line or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ blouse I remember is the one on the line, which was mended in 1972 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ blouse, my grandmother said in 1975, is the only thing that improves by being mended; every blouse, she said, is a summer that has agreed to look like a garment. She said the summer was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 衬衫（指衣服本身，与扣子相对）
C. 固定搭配：iron a blouse 熨一件衬衫
D. n. 衬衫（指衣柜里每一件）
E. n. 衬衫（指绳上晾的那一件）
F. n. 衬衫（抽象：它所代表的那个夏天）
G. n. 那个夏天（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a blouse she could not fasten
The blouse, meaning the garment and not the buttons
blouse was the whole of the summer
the blouse had become a photograph in a report
The blouse of the whole thing
A blouse, my grandmother said in 1975

answers.why: iron a blouse 意为“熨一件衬衫”，1953 年母亲被派去熨一件她扣不上的衬衫。
blouse 意为“衬衫”，指衣服本身而不是扣子，有十一颗扣子，由最后走的人熨平。
blouse 指衣柜里每一件衬衫，每一件都是同样的领子。
blouse 指绳上晾着那一件（她穿去面试的那件），是唯一有人认真洗过的。
blouse 意为“衬衫”，抽象指它所代表的那个夏天，父亲说 blouse 就是那个夏天的全部。
blouse 为抽象用法，指那个夏天本身，是屋子里人人都拍照、却没人质疑的东西。
blouse 意为“女衬衫、上衣”，到 1969 年这件 blouse 成了报告里的一张照片。
blouse 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是十一颗扣子和十一年的熨烫。
blouse 意为“衬衫”，我记得的是绳上那一件，1972 年补过，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
blouse 为抽象总称，祖母说衬衫是唯一会因为被缝补而变好的东西。
